title: Question answered confidently by a human
description: A factual question is immediately and credibly answered. ThirdSeat must stay silent.
objective: Select an architecture approach for the event pipeline.

lines.text: We need durable fan-out for these events.
Does AWS support fan-out from SNS to multiple SQS queues?
Yes. We already use SNS to SQS fan-out for that in the billing project, it works fine.
Great, then the pipeline can follow the same pattern.
Agreed, let's sketch the consumers next.
